newsitem.title: UK: Eurotunnel Nov traffic data reflects fire.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel Nov traffic data reflects fire.

text.p: Eurotunnel Plc said on Monday that its November traffic figures showed 142,047 Le Shuttle tourist cars went through the tunnel and 4,722 coaches.

That comapres with 129,286 cars last November and 5,120 coaches, said a company statement. Eurotunnel admitted that "traffic levels for November 1996 have of course been affected by temporary suspension of services following the incident (fire) in the tunnel on November 18." It said rail freight services restarted on November 21. Eurostar passenger trains restarted on December 4 and the Le Shuttle tourist services begin on Tuesday.
